title: Config change -> cohort projection & stability evals for embeddings/rerank
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: implement an automated evaluation and projection pipeline that runs whenever a serving configuration or model variant for embeddings/rerankers changes. The goal is to predict downstream cohort-level recall/precision impact and surface stability signals (distribution shifts, embedding norm drift, and ranking flips) before rollout.

Scope: offline-only evaluations and gates for config/model changes that are executed pre-rollout (canary shadow runs or config preview). This ticket covers the pipeline, metrics, gating thresholds, reporting, and a lightweight projection model used to estimate expected customer impact for affected cohorts. Does not include online A/B rollout automation (separate ticket).

Signals to compute: offline recall@k and precision@k per cohort (k=1,5,10), mean reciprocal rank (MRR), fraction of queries with top-1 rank flip vs baseline, embedding cosine centroid shift, embedding norm distribution shift (KS-test), per-cohort coverage (fraction of queries with non-empty top-K), and a synthetic probe set score (pre-specified probes).

Projection model: a simple linear model (ridge) that maps historical metric deltas (recall/precision shifts, norm delta, centroid cosine) to expected downstream SLA risk score. Model will be trained on backfilled historical config changes + incident/regression tags. Output: expected risk bucket {none, low, medium, high}.

Gating policy: changes tagged with expected risk >= medium require a manual review + must pass a shadow canary for 48h or be rolled back. Changes with high risk are blocked from auto-rollout and require PM/Eng signoff. Thresholds: recall@10 drop > 2.5% for high risk; recall@10 drop between 1% and 2.5% -> medium. Rank flip > 5% -> medium, >10% -> high. Norm distribution KS p-value < 0.01 -> medium. These thresholds are configurable via a small calibration table stored in s3 and surfaced in the report.

Pipeline steps: 1) detect config/model change event from config store; 2) materialize relevant query cohorts (daily, weekly) and sample based on traffic; 3) run embedding and reranker offline (onestep scoring) against baseline and candidate; 4) compute metrics and statistical tests; 5) run projection model; 6) render HTML/JSON report and post to PR and to the Config-Gates dashboard.

Acceptance criteria: automated runs trigger for every config change in staging; pipeline computes all listed signals within budgeted infra (<= 1200 GPU seconds per run); projection model produces risk bucket and aligns with historical incidents on backfill (precision >= 0.7 for medium+ incidents); report posted to PR and to dashboard; gating rules enforced by CI check that fails PR when risk >= high and flags when risk >= medium.

Observability: add tracing and per-run telemetry: run duration, GPU seconds, sample size per cohort, metric deltas, projection score, and gating decision. Persist run artifacts (metrics CSV + small digest JSON) to s3 with stable path, include link in report.

Ownership: infra/serving (Miguel) implements runner and CI integration; applied-ml (Asha) owns projection model and thresholds; product (PM) to review default thresholds and UI copy.

Notes/Non-goals: this ticket does not tweak production routing or implement automatic rollback. Also avoids heavy-weight per-query rerun; uses sampled cohorts for cost control.
